firmware.name: Fleet heartbeat / CSI node (ESP32-C6)
firmware.description: Wi-Fi fleet node firmware for the ESP32-C6: posts a fleet heartbeat and streams Channel State Information (CSI) for presence/occupancy sensing. Joins the mesh as a node and shows up in FleetView.

firmware.name: clawft-edge-pad display firmware (ESP32-S3)
firmware.description: Touch-display firmware for ESP32-S3 RGB-parallel panels (Elecrow CrowPanel family). esp-hal 1.0 LCD_CAM DPI + esp-rtos/embassy + embedded-graphics; signs as an Inkpad Actor (ADR-025/057). Renders the HUD and reads the capacitive touch panel.

firmware.name: weftos-mic-node (I2S MEMS mic)
firmware.description: Audio node firmware that captures from an I2S MEMS microphone (INMP441-class), runs the voice/VAD gate, and publishes acoustic events to the mesh. Telemetry-first, fail-honest on no audio.

firmware.name: Cognitum Seed firmware
firmware.description: Base firmware for the Cognitum Seed AI appliance (ARM): local inference, vector store, cog host and OTA. Cogs are installed on top over MCP; this is the appliance image the cogs run against.
